7963.title: Scheduler progress in a desktop watcher test
7963.rootCauseOneLine: The test stops flushing its manual scheduler before an in-flight lock read queues a requested recheck, so the move callback never runs.

prReviews.verdict: Addresses the verified cause (static review only)
prReviews.topFinding: The one-file diff drives the manual scheduler during the callback wait; the PR branch was not executed.

7963.proposedFix: Continue driving the manual scheduler while waiting for exactly-once move delivery; retain the watcher and cleanup assertions without changing production code.
7963.caveats: The complete reproduction patch is inline in the HTML, per reports repository policy. The same agent performed both clean-checkout runs. No duplicate fix PR: linked PR 7964 is open.
